explanation_full: The Random Forest model exhibits strong predictive performance as evidenced by its high R2 score of 0.7756. This indicates that the model effectively captures the relationship between input features and target variable. The low RMSE (0.1254) and MAE (0.0836) values further confirm the accuracy of the model's predictions, indicating minimal error between predicted and actual values.  Residual analysis shows a relatively even distribution around the zero line, suggesting that there is no systematic bias in the model's predictions. The scatter plot visualizes this relationship, with data points clustered closely around the regression line, demonstrating the model's ability to accurately capture the underlying trend in the data.
